summary: Indian train simulator & train game: drive real routes, build your railway.
description:
🚆 Indian Train Simulator – The Real Indian Railway Experience 🚆
Drive across India’s vast rail network with realistic graphics, smooth controls, and authentic trains. With long-distance routes, iconic stations, and powerful locomotives, this is more than a game—it’s the ultimate Indian train simulator.

Players call it a train wala game, a train wali game, or simply the best train gadi game on mobile — the one that actually feels like Indian Railways. If you have been looking for a train chalane wala game with real routes and real signals, this is it. One of the most played train games and train simulator titles in India.

🌟 Why Players Love It
* Realistic graphics & physics for a true railway feel
* Smooth controls with throttle, brakes & signals system
* Authentic Indian Railways locomotives & coaches (WAP4, WAP7, WDP4D, WDG4, Tejas, Rajdhani, Palace on Wheels, Vande Bharat & more)
* Long routes, junctions, ghat sections, tunnels & level crossings
* Realistic announcements, horns & station vibes 🚉

🛤️ Routes, Maps & Stations
* Day, night & weather driving 🌙🌧️
* Explore routes across Kashmir, Kerala, Punjab, UP, Maharashtra, Telangana & more
* Famous junctions: Delhi, Mumbai, Lucknow, Chennai, Varanasi, Howrah, Nagpur, Hyderabad & more
* Toll booths, crossings, busy junctions & realistic signalling 🚦
* Long journeys with proper distances (no tiny loops)

🚆 Locomotives & Coaches
* Drive iconic diesel & electric engines: WAP, WDP, WDG, WDM series
* High-speed Vande Bharat & Amrit Bharat Express 🚄
* Variety of coaches: ICF, LHB, Humsafar, Tejas, Rajdhani, freight wagons & more
* Customization: liveries, mixed rakes, interiors & horns
* Upgrade horns, sounds & headlights for realism

🎮 Game Modes & Features
* Career mode with missions, permits & timed runs
* Custom mode – build your own route & rake combinations
* Challenge mode – tough scenarios with signals & speed limits
* First-person cab view with working mirrors, gauges & controls
* Independent brakes, coupling/decoupling & passenger features
* Radio/music & Indian announcements for immersion

⚡ Optimised For Every Phone
* Lite graphics preset + dynamic resolution for smooth FPS
* Strong performance and low heating on popular devices
* Free starter locomotives so you can drive right away

❤️ What Players Say
* “Best train game on mobile”
* “Feels like real Indian Railways”
* “Great graphics & realistic horns”
* “Long routes & proper stations—love it”

🙌 Coming Next
* Offline mode for core routes
* New routes: Konkan Railway, Delhi–Lucknow, Mumbai–Goa & more

🎯 Why Choose Indian Train Simulator?
It is the most complete Indian railway simulator on mobile — real routes, real locomotives, real signalling. Whether you want a relaxed long-distance train game or a strict railway simulator with permits and speed limits, both are here.

🚆 Download now and join millions of loco pilots driving across India.
⭐ Indian Train Simulator – Drive India. Drive Real. ⭐
